title: A task moves into the day
summary: The Dayfold workspace stays fixed while one gold task moves from the inbox into the calendar. A six-second hold gives the viewer time to check the result.
rules: Composition: Place the copy in the left third of the 1280 × 720 frame. Keep the 720 px interface on the right with the inbox and calendar visible together.
Color: Use warm paper behind the interface and cobalt for text and controls. Reserve gold for the selected task; switch it to pale blue after it lands.
Motion: Let the pointer select the task and activate Schedule for today. Move just that card from 6.9 to 8.6 seconds. The rest of the interface stays still.
Static view: Hold on the result from 10 seconds. Keep the moved task and the 09:30–10:30 confirmation in view. Use this frame as the poster and keep playback user-initiated.

palette.label: Pale blue for the scheduled card

mainImage.alt: A gold task card reading Review launch script is halfway from the inbox to the calendar.
mainImage.caption: 7.8 s · The task straddles the two panes. The surrounding interface stays still, so the movement has a visible origin and destination.

staticImage.alt: The Review launch script card appears in Today with Scheduled · 09:30–10:30 below it.
staticImage.caption: 12 s · The final state shows the task, its assigned time, and the two untouched tasks.
